verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs clearly describe capturing traces, spans, and sessions with inputs/outputs via its Python SDK and OpenTelemetry integration (galileo-docs-6, galileo-gh-1, galileo-docs-7), and pricing mentions per-trace usage limits (galileo-docs-27), confirming trace capture is core to the product. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit confirmation that latency and token-usage metrics are captured as part of these traces. missing for 10: explicit documentation citing latency measurement, explicit documentation citing token usage/cost tracking per trace.
